title: 10x Claude Code for Cold Email: 9 tools, 8 with MCP
instagram:
Claude Code can write your cold emails. These 9 tools find who to send them to. 🤖

❌ Copy-pasting lead lists into chat.
✅ Claude Code calling your data and sending tools directly.

Here is the stack:

Lead generation
1️⃣ Apollo: 240M+ contacts, 30M+ accounts. Official MCP.
2️⃣ PredictLeads: company signals on 120M+ companies. MCP + API.
3️⃣ DiscoLike: search 82M+ business websites. MCP for Claude Code.
4️⃣ GetLeads: 542M+ B2B contacts, queried by prompt. Remote MCP.
5️⃣ ColdIQ: one chat, MCP and API over 40+ data providers.

Outreach and sending
6️⃣ lemlist: multichannel sequences. Official MCP.
7️⃣ Instantly: cold email at scale. Official MCP.
8️⃣ Expandi: LinkedIn automation. MCP in beta.
9️⃣ Hypertide: cold email inboxes on Google, Microsoft and Entra. API.

8 of the 10 connect to Claude over MCP. Numbers checked on each vendor's own site, 1 Nov 2026.

Stay legal: follow anti-spam and data protection rules in your country before you send a single email.
